verdict.rationale: The pack documents no bulk-operation capability, such as bulk-editing, bulk-issuing, or bulk-terminating many stakeholders or securities at once. The documented actions are per-item: terminating a stakeholder is done by clicking an individual stakeholder, and merging duplicates is pairwise. The Excel cap-table template and migration import are a one-time onboarding data load, not an operation run across many items, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
